summary: Epsilon Energy Ltd. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement registering a $15 million at-the-market (ATM) equity offering. The company entered into an ATM Agreement with Roth Capital Partners, allowing the sale of common shares from time to time at market prices with a 3% commission. No specific terms, dates, or pricing are established. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category. No board recommendation, deal terms, or strategic event is mentioned.
